recreation_notes.text:
Notepad++ search term: '(?!;)(.*)(video\()
unsigned char - ""
!= - <>
(?!\t)(.*)\-=(.*) - \1 = \1 - \2
(?!\t)(.*)\+=(.*) - \1 = \1 + \2
(?!(\t|s|u|b| ))(.*)\((.*, .*)\) - \2 \3
void - Sub
\nint - Function
(\n)End If - (\n)End Sub
ghostmove\((.*)\) - ghostMove \1
light\((.*)\) - light \1
video\('(\w)', '(\w)', '(\w)' (.*)\) - video "\1", "\2", "\3" \4
\treturn - \tExit Sub   But watch out for something after Exit Sub as it indicates a function return
